interpretation: Forcing the current MOV emitter regressed the compute, call-heavy, and memory-heavy fixture medians. The SSE fixture emitted no code. These local samples keep the current emitter disabled by default and do not establish a product performance target.
measurementScope: The benchmark loads the raw WASM artifact and measures fixture guest execution under Node. It does not measure Asyncify callback overhead, browser rendering, or the Diligent target.
